serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: TriageXpert Cloud is a physician-written, evidence-based clinical decision support tool that generates a comprehensive triage note. Through a custom algorithm and natural language processing, clinical users are guided through a targeted medical history with a recommended treatment path. TriageXpert is available as an API or easy to deploy widget.
